# VidFare

> What every AI video second costs, everywhere.

VidFare compares AI video generation prices in dollars per second of finished video, across APIs and credit plans. Figures are copied from each vendor's own pricing page. Last full check: 2026-10-31. 184 current prices.

## Weekly price reports

Published on Friday when at least two verified changes were checked. A change is a per-second price move, a promo start, or a promo end. A shorter week rolls forward.

- https://sheepinboots.github.io/clipcost/reports/
- https://sheepinboots.github.io/clipcost/reports/2026-w44/
